summary: On the Access map, giving and removing access are now separate buttons you cannot confuse.

fixes.title: Give and remove are separate buttons
fixes.text: Give access is blue and Remove access is red, and each list shows only that direction's choices. A click can never do the opposite of what you pressed.

fixes.title: Staged changes are easy to tell apart
fixes.text: A staged addition is amber and says "staged add"; a staged removal is red, struck through and says "staged remove".

fixes.title: The selection bar stays in view
fixes.text: The bar showing your selection and its buttons now sticks to the bottom of the screen, tinted blue while giving and red while removing.

fixes.title: Clearer link names
fixes.text: Links now use the record names shown elsewhere, for example "Open Service groups in All records".
